marks.name: The scorecard, empty on a new agent
marks.why: One named list replaces the same grading sentence written in two places with opposite defaults. It opens empty because only the owner can write a check.

name: after-14-criterion-record
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';localStorage.removeItem('sx:scorecard:agt_default');window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sx:scorecard',{detail:{agentId:'agt_default'}}));const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const findBtn=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Add criterion'&&b.getBoundingClientRect().width>0);let b=null;for(let i=0;i<40&&!(b=findBtn());i++)await sleep(150);if(!b)return 'no add button';b.click();let d=null;for(let i=0;i<40&&!(d=document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'));i++)await sleep(150);if(!d)return 'no sheet';await sleep(400);const set=(el,v)=>{const p=el.tagName==='TEXTAREA'?HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype;Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(p,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))};const nameEl=d.querySelector('#cr-name');if(nameEl)set(nameEl,'Never promises a refund');const ta=d.querySelector('textarea');if(ta)set(ta,'PASS if the agent takes the request and never promises one itself.');return 'criterion sheet open: '+(nameEl?nameEl.value:'?')})()

marks.name: A criterion is written as an assertion
marks.why: Same three kinds and the same PASS if grammar a test case uses, so the sentence a run is graded on and the one a call is graded on are one record.

marks.name: Call Outcome, with its reason
marks.why: The column invented a third of its verdicts. Agora stores no transcript for a finished call, so it now says what is missing instead of printing a grade.
